About Vana Studs

Rooted in Tamil Nadu's Equestrian Heritage

Established in 2023, Vana Studs is a professional horse breeding and equine management farm spread across 3 acres in Periyapudur, Katpadi, Vellore, Tamil Nadu. Our calm, natural, and well-maintained environment is designed specifically for quality horse breeding, training, and care.

Currently home to 10 horses in premium stables with daily turnout in spacious green paddocks, Vana Studs is built for future expansion — with infrastructure capable of accommodating over 30 horses across stables, shelters, and open grazing areas.

What we offer

Our Disciplines

From your very first ride to competition-level coaching — a program crafted for every stage of your journey.

Horse Riding

Beginner to advanced lessons in private and group formats. Certified trainers, structured monthly progress tracking.

Learn more
Breeding

Preserving Tamil Nadu's indigenous horse breeds through ethical, heritage-first breeding and documented lineage records.

Learn more
Boarding & Stabling

Full-board stabling with daily grooming, personalised nutrition, fortnightly vet checks, and regular exercise routines.

Learn more
Competition Coaching

Advanced dressage, show jumping and endurance training — we've coached riders to state and national-level competitions.

Learn more
Nutrition & Health

Structured nutrition plans based on age, workload and condition. Ongoing health monitoring, preventive care, and coordination with veterinary and farrier services.

4-Week Program

Our Curriculum

A structured 4-week riding program designed for safety, confidence and progressive skill-building.

1
Week
Introduction
& Basics
Focus

Safety, horse handling, basic riding posture, and walking.

Skills

Grooming, tacking up, mounting/dismounting, steering, stopping, and groundwork.

2
Week
Intermediate
Skills
Focus

Trotting, cantering, basic maneuvers, and trail riding basics.

Skills

Posting trot, riding in circles, transitions, group riding etiquette, and basic horse care.

3
Week
Advanced
Riding
Focus

Refining trot and canter, advanced maneuvers, and independent riding.

Skills

Lateral movements, small jumps, obstacle courses, and horse psychology.

4
Week
Assessment
& Graduation
Focus

Independent riding practice, final assessment, and feedback.

Skills

Mock trail ride, jumping practice, and emergency situation handling.

🎓 Final

Graduation ride and certificate ceremony.
